findings.title: Waterings bed filter is lost on reload: page writes ?bed_id= to the URL but only reads ?bed=
findings.expected: After choosing a bed in the filter and reloading, the same bed stays selected and only its waterings are listed
findings.actual: Choosing North bed changes the URL to /waterings?bed_id=1; reloading that URL resets the select to 'All beds' and lists waterings from every bed (the page only reads the 'bed' query parameter, which is what the beds page links use)

findings.title: Hung filter request leaves the waterings page stuck on 'Loading waterings…' showing other beds' rows
findings.expected: A request that never answers ends in a visible error or timeout, and rows for other beds are not shown under the chosen bed's filter
findings.actual: 13 s after picking 'Shade corner' the page still says 'Loading waterings…' and still lists all four waterings, including North bed's, under the Shade corner filter. It never times out and shows no error
